question.text: The ratio of surface tensions of mercury and water is given to be <math><mn>7.5</mn></math>, while the ratio of their densities is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>13.6</mn></math>. Their contact angles, with glass, are close to <math><mn>135</mn><mo>°</mo></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>°</mo></math>, respectively.
